refinement.title: Refinement in Lighthouse: refine what is relevant
refinement.description: How much should your team refine before the next Refinement? Lighthouse answers from the team's own history, and everyone votes on one question per item before the meeting: could we finish it within our SLE?

install.title: Lighthouse: from installation to data in 60 seconds
install.description: How quickly you get from installing Lighthouse on your own machine to the first data from your tracker.
